title: The Hollow Hill
text: A round door painted blue is set in a green hill, with music, light and laughter spilling out from inside. A small figure at the door bows you in, smiling with too many teeth. Everyone knows that time runs strangely under hills. The music is very good.

options.label: Go in for one night. The music is very good, and you are very tired.

outcomes.text: After a night of feasting you come out the next morning well fed and only a little older.
You come out after one night to find a week has passed. Something of the music stayed in you, and it will not leave.

options.label: Leave a gift at the door, and go on before the music takes you.

outcomes.text: The small figure takes it gravely, then gives one back with too many teeth.

options.label: Refuse, politely. Time runs strangely under hills.

outcomes.text: The door closes and the music stops. Nobody mentions it, but for a day everyone hums the tune and is cheered by it.

options.label: The one with an instrument plays at the door, and offers a song of their own.

outcomes.text: The music inside stops to listen. When it starts again it plays your tune, and the small figure brings the player a gift for it.
